parameters.name: AttributeValue
parameters.description: The value of a user group property. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the user group. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It supports both uppercase and lowercase letters and Chinese characters.

parameters.name: PAPolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of an internal network access policy. You can get this value from:

- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): List internal network access policies.

- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): Create an internal network access policy.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: UserGroupIds
parameters.description: A collection of user group IDs. You can specify up to 100 IDs.
